exposure: protein-rich food (dairy, meat, fish and egg) intake
weight-for-length growth velocity from 6 to 12 months of age
growth velocity from 0 to 6 months of age
outcome: body composition at 2-3 years of age
Fat-free mass index Z score at 2-3 years of age
cohort: The study participants were 36 children from the Feeding Queensland Babies Study Cohort.
finding: Fat-free mass index Z score at 2-3 years of age was positively associated with animal protein food intake at 12 months and negatively associated with weight-for-length growth velocity from 6 to 12 months of age.
